display.purpose: Monumental uppercase hero and section headlines (Saira Condensed 800).

command.purpose: Capability names, sheet titles, masthead (Saira Condensed 700, uppercase).

label.purpose: Section labels, figure captions, status readouts (Overpass Mono, tracked, uppercase).

mono.purpose: Grades, citations, counters, timestamps, coordinates — tabular figures.

shadows.name: sheet-lift
shadows.purpose: The one warm estimate sheet, lifted onto the dark operations ground. Dark surfaces otherwise carry no shadow.

shadows.name: button-hover-glow
shadows.purpose: Low olive glow under the primary action on hover.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out for reveals, counters, and state transitions.

motion.name: counter-count-up
motion.purpose: Archive instrument counters animate from 0 when scrolled into view; the signature interaction (reliability scrub) is instant.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Restrained one-shot scroll reveal; honored only when prefers-reduced-motion is not set.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The operational primary action (Request access). Olive-drab slab, square, uppercase command type.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.55rem; background:#B2AA7D; color:#14170D; font-family:'Saira Condensed',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:14px; letter-spacing:0.04em; text-transform:uppercase; padding:0.85rem 1.4rem; border:1px solid #B2AA7D; border-radius:0; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), background-color 180ms, box-shadow 180ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#C6BE8F; box-shadow:0 6px 22px -6px rgba(178,170,125,0.24); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action (Sign in). Transparent with a hairline border that shifts olive on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem; background:transparent; color:#E7E6DC; font-family:'Saira Condensed',sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:14px; letter-spacing:0.04em; text-transform:uppercase; padding:0.85rem 1.3rem; border:1px solid #2C3430; border-radius:0; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color 180ms, color 180ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color:#B2AA7D; color:#B2AA7D; }

components.name: Reliability Grade Chip
components.description: NATO admiralty source grade (reliability A–F / credibility 1–6). Border color encodes reliability band.
components.css: .ds-grade { font-family:'Overpass Mono',monospace; font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.04em; padding:1px 5px; border:1px solid currentColor; display:inline-flex; line-height:1.35; } .ds-grade-hi { color:#4E6B34; } .ds-grade-lo { color:#B03A2A; }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: Mono uppercase label used for figure captions and status readouts.
components.css: .ds-label { font-family:'Overpass Mono',monospace; font-size:10.5px; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.16em; color:#99A08F; }

components.name: Reliability Scrub
components.description: Plotting-style range slider that sets the minimum acceptable source reliability; bare track, thin signal-red thumb.
components.html: <input class="ds-range" type="range" min="0" max="5" value="0" aria-label="Minimum source reliability">
components.css: .ds-range { -webkit-appearance:none; appearance:none; width:100%; height:22px; background:transparent; cursor:ew-resize; } .ds-range::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height:2px; background:#C6BC9F; } .ds-range::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance:none; width:3px; height:22px; margin-top:-10px; background:#B03A2A; border:none; border-radius:0; } .ds-range:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #B03A2A; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Flat dark surface with a 1px rule and drawn olive registration ticks; no shadow.
components.css: .ds-panel { position:relative; background:#101514; color:#E7E6DC; border:1px solid #1F2624; border-radius:0; padding:24px; font-family:'Public Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-reg::before, .ds-reg::after { content:''; position:absolute; width:9px; height:9px; border:1px solid #B2AA7D; } .ds-reg::before { top:-1px; left:-1px; border-right:none; border-bottom:none; } .ds-reg::after { bottom:-1px; right:-1px; border-left:none; border-top:none; }

narrative.overview: SoldierIQ answers as a finished all-source intelligence estimate — an assessed answer, a confidence lexicon, and footnoted source-reliability grading. The identity makes that literal: the surface is a dark analytic operations ground on which a single warm estimate sheet is worked. Provenance is not a claim on this page, it is the material — a real cited assessment with a reliability ledger the visitor can re-grade in their own hands. The world deliberately refuses the two ruts this category falls into: the dark-HUD tactical dashboard and the neutral enterprise-AI hero. It is mission-grade without cosplay: authority comes from the analytic-document tradition, not from HUD decoration.
keyCharacteristics: A dark graphite-green operations ground carrying one warm, worked estimate sheet.
Condensed command display (Saira) + government body (Public Sans) + Highway-Gothic mono (Overpass Mono).
Square corners, hairline rules, drawn marks — no pills, no soft shadows on dark, no glyph icons.
Every metric and citation is real data type (tabular mono), never mono-as-costume.
One authored interaction — the reliability scrub — carries the thesis; motion elsewhere is restrained.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Olive drab is the only saturated brand color and stays under ~10% of any screen; its rarity is the authority. Signal red is rarer still and means classification, citation, or alarm — never emphasis.

rules.name: The Warm Sheet Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one light surface — the estimate sheet. It earns focus by contrast; do not add second and third paper panels or the proof loses its weight.

rules.name: The Data-Is-Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only on real measurement — grades, citations, counts, timestamps, coordinates. It is never a technical costume on prose.

rules.name: The Flat-Ground Rule
rules.body: Dark surfaces never carry shadows; they layer by tone and hairline. Shadow is reserved for the one paper object.

dos: Do keep the ground flat and layer by tone + 1px hairlines; reserve shadow for the one paper sheet.
Do render every metric, grade, citation, and timestamp in Overpass Mono with tabular figures.
Do let headlines stand alone; use figure captions (Fig. N —) only on an actual figure.
Do keep olive drab sparse (<=10%) and signal red rarer still (classification / citation / alarm only).
Do label all demonstration data synthetic.
donts: Don't add eyebrows/kickers above headings, decorative section numbers on non-sequential items, or glyph/emoji icons.
Don't introduce a second light/paper panel — one estimate sheet only.
Don't use pills, rounded cards, gradient text, or HUD/terminal chrome.
Don't invent customers, benchmarks, pricing, or deployment claims.
